answer: I ran the Bell circuit on garnet:mock with 100 shots. The server lists the mock as "garnet:mock", so I used that alias for "garnet-mock". The circuit puts H on q0, then a CNOT from q0 to q1, then measures both qubits. Job 01a15fb1-08b4-764b-88f8-c5963266de23 completed with counts 00: 26, 01: 26, 10: 23, 11: 25. The mock backend returns random results, so the counts are spread evenly instead of mostly 00 and 11. The helper estimated the credit cost at 0.
